title: Packaging Switchboard as a Nua-deployable service puts the record layer in Abilian's own PaaS catalogue
content:
This proposal has two halves and only one of them is an integration. The integration half is a Django signal dispatching typed operations from Abilian SBE. The other half is distribution: Switchboard packaged as a Nua-deployable service, which makes the record layer an item in the partner's own platform-as-a-service catalogue.

That second half is a different kind of move from anything else in this part of the corpus. Every other group proposes a demo that shows a capability; this one proposes that the capability become part of what the partner already sells and operates. The integration then serves as the worked example of a catalogue entry rather than as the deliverable itself.

The single lead is Abilian in Paris, marked "2 · next". The metasfresh group makes a similar argument from the reseller side — ship inside the partner's channel, not beside it — which suggests the distribution framing is worth generalising to partners who run their own platform or store.
